Package aor.proj3t.util.converterutils

Interface Converter<E,D>

Type Parameters:
E - The entity type (domain model object)
D - The DTO type (data transfer object)
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractConverter, EvaluationConverter, EvaluationCycleConverter, MessageConverter, NotificationConverter, PendingRegistrationConverter, ResetPasswordConverter, SessionConverter, SettingsConverter, TrainingAreaConverter, TrainingConverter, TrainingParticipationConverter, UserConverter, WorkplaceConverter
public interface Converter<E,D>
Generic interface for bidirectional conversion between entities and DTOs. This interface defines the contract for converting between domain entities and data transfer objects (DTOs). It provides methods for converting individual objects as well as collections of objects in both directions. Implementing classes should provide efficient and consistent conversion logic that preserves the integrity of the data being transferred.

  • Method Details

    • toDTO

      D toDTO(E entity)
      Converts an entity to its corresponding DTO. This method transforms a domain entity into a data transfer object that can be safely used in the presentation layer or API responses. It extracts the relevant data from the entity while hiding implementation details and sensitive information.
      Parameters:
      entity - The entity to convert
      Returns:
      The converted DTO, or null if entity is null

    • toEntity

      E toEntity(D dto)
      Converts a DTO to its corresponding entity. This method transforms a data transfer object into a domain entity that can be used by business logic or persisted in a database. It applies business rules and validates the data during the conversion process, ensuring that the resulting entity is in a valid state.
      Parameters:
      dto - The DTO to convert
      Returns:
      The converted entity, or null if dto is null

    • toDTOList

      default List<D> toDTOList(List<E> entityList)
      Converts a list of entities to a list of DTOs. This method transforms a collection of domain entities into a collection of data transfer objects. It provides a convenient way to convert entire collections in a single operation. If the input list is null, an empty list is returned.
      Parameters:
      entityList - The list of entities to convert
      Returns:
      A list of converted DTOs, never null

    • toEntityList

      default List<E> toEntityList(List<D> dtoList)
      Converts a list of DTOs to a list of entities. This method transforms a collection of data transfer objects into a collection of domain entities. It provides a convenient way to convert entire collections in a single operation. If the input list is null, an empty list is returned.
      Parameters:
      dtoList - The list of DTOs to convert
      Returns:
      A list of converted entities, never null
